_comment: Card render presets shown in Settings > Appearance > Card render, next to the plain images. Each entry is ONE complete generated-card design: `id` is what the account stores, `name` is the label per language (falls back to the id), `requiresDeveloperMode` hides the entry until the basic developer mode is on, and the rest is applied to every generated card. `animation` carries one block per layout (animateBackground / animateUnderlay and the scale each layer keeps when it is NOT animated); backgroundZoomPercent / underlayZoomPercent are the maximum zoom of each layer, blurPx the blur at the deepest point of the background zoom. `rarities` declares tier 1 (common) to 6 (unique) with the frame colour, the accent colour, the symbol printed at the top right and its colour. Every number is clamped to the ranges of `cardGenerate` in settings/config.json, so a hand-edited preset can only cost a narrower effect, never a broken card. To add a mode, copy an entry from Settings > Account > Advanced developer options > Card Generate ('Copy the JSON of this mode'), paste it here and give it a new id.
